label: event held in place
definition: Event X takes or took place in geographic location Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit event held-in or occurring-in Y; an event actually brought to or taking place in Y; historical event location. Excludes: a team's organizational location or ordinary person travel; attendance originating from Y; a place merely bidding or competing to host X; discussion of an event in a publication. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: proposed, hoped-for, or future hosting without realization; generic have/bring/lure with missing modality; place versus institution or event identity unresolved. This requires event occurrence at the location, not only a bid or planned destination.

facts.reason: Olympics → New York: Held/come-to is mixed with entice/lure hosting-bid wording, leaving actual event occurrence unresolved.
facts.reviewer_question: Does the text assert that an Olympics actually occurred in New York, or only a proposed hosting bid?

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
